title: GTA 6 Is Giving Pornhub A Hard Time
description: Not even porn is immune to the GTA 6 effect, as it's just one of several forms of entertainment that has seen a decline in viewership since the massive open-world game launched. It's not surprising, given the game's record-breaking start, with 32.5 million sales from preorders alone. On PS5, GTA 6 is the "biggest launch" in PlayStation history, and players spent an average of 17.4 hours playing in its first few days--which probably didn't leave much time for a quick browse of after-hours material. According to Mashable, US traffic on Pornhub--which I've been told is one of the largest pornography websites, by traffic--dipped by as much as 15.5% an hour after GTA 6 launched. Paradoxically, Pornhub traffic had actually been up by 16.5% compared to average days, likely indicating that people were bored and randy. Pornhub traffic started to fluctuate after the GTA 6 launch and reached an average peak a few days later. Thanks to the game's massive success, we're also seeing the Rule 34 effect on GTA 6, as Mashable's research noted a 16,196% spike in GTA-related searches. Up to 15 million search queries were made on November 18 alone, with users searching for GTA 6, the GTA 6 strip club, and content depicting the co-protagonist Lucia specifically. The fan-favorite stalker--and possible serial killer--Mandy also appeared in search results, while Lucia's partner-in-crime Jason ranked low. Thursday Night Football also saw a big dip last week, with the lowest viewership of the season so far for a TNF game. While Rockstar's new open-world adventure can't be blamed entirely for that dip, it certainly must have had an impact, given that the football game was held on GTA 6's launch day. That effect didn't extend to the box office, as The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping opened to a massive $120 million in the US, almost triple that of the last film in the series, The Ballad of Songbirds and Snakes. For more GTA 6 news, you can read up on how modders are attempting to make an…

title: Thursday Night Football Had Lowest Viewership All Season On GTA 6 Launch Day
description: The Thursday Night Football matchup on November 19, the day that GTA 6 came out, had the lowest viewership of the entire season so far for a TNF game, but the low ratings might not be due entirely to competition with GTA 6. The data shows that 12.23 million people, on average, watched the November 19 matchup between the Indianapolis Colts and Houston Texans on Prime Video. That was a 9% slide from the Week 11 Thursday Night Football matchup in 2025 featuring the New England Patriots and New York Jets. Looking at week-over-week, the November 12 matchup this year between the Washington Commanders and New York Giants drew 16.27 million viewers, and was up 17% compared to the Week 10 matchup in 2025 featuring the Las Vegas Raiders and Denver Broncos. Due to the poor ratings of the November 19 TNF game, the full-season average now for TNF games this season sank to 16.62 million on per game. One expert told GameSpot that live sports like football probably won't be too heavily impacted by GTA 6 because people want to watch in real time. The low ratings for the November 19 matchup could be partially attributable to competition with GTA 6, but a likelier scenario is that people tuned out because it was a boring game in which the heavily favored Texans throttled the Colts by a score of 26-3. The Texans were up 17-3 at the half, and the game only had nine more points total scored in the second half--all by the Texans. Not exactly thrilling stuff that people would stay glued to. Ahead of GTA 6's launch, people also wondered how The Hunger Games: Sunrise on the Reaping, which released on November 20, might be impacted. It may have been, but the film still put up massive numbers at the box office that exceeded expectations. GTA 6 sold 32.5 million copies via pre-purchases alone and generated close to $4 billion on day one. The game will continue to sell, and it should get another jolt of sales when the PC edition arrives in 2027, as rumored. If you're just getting started, be…

title: GTA 6 Has A Secret Mission That Feels Like Hard Target Meets Saw
description: In the mood for a little bloodsport? In GTA 6, you can teach one loud-mouthed hunter that Lucia (or Jason) is the deadliest game, as this secret mission will require cunning and sharp shooting to survive. It's Hard Target meets SAW, and the victor gets a pretty sizable stack of cash. Here's how you can be the most elusive of quarry. Go to Hyde Island Located north of Lummox County and the Moreau River, Hyde Island is where you can start this mission. All you have to do is land on the island, and after a few steps, a dart will hit you and knock you out. Listen to your captor's speech Now for the boring part. You'll wake up inside of a shipping container, with a fashionable explosive necklace locked in place. Once your captor finishes his rant, the game begins, and you'll want to move. Run to the tent directly in front of you You'll have 10 seconds to reach a tent in front of you, where you'll find a gun and a paltry two rounds for the sidearm. After the count is up, a hunter on a quad bike will show up, and he'll be gunning for you. To make things worse, he also has a dog with him that'll track you throughout the island. Don't engage him; he's heavily armored, and two bullets aren't nearly enough to stop him—besides, you'll need those rounds for his dog, Caesar. Sorry, animal lovers. Search for more outposts You can find more ammo, adrenaline, and a shotgun at nearby outposts. Each one is lit up, so be fast, be sneaky, and try not to get caught. The hunter is going to be tracking you constantly, even without his dog, and he has a sniper rifle that can take you out in just a few shots if he catches you. Prepare for a showdown Get as much ammo as you can, and choose your spot for the last stand. The hunter's dog will be a pest, so deal with it first. It's easy to spot, with a red light on its collar. Trees also make for good cover against the hunter, so once he's in range, start nailing him with shots to critical areas. Once he stumbles, unload a few shotgun rounds…

title: Ghostrunner 2’s Complete Edition Has Never Been Cheaper, So Sharpen Your Katana
description: Ghostrunner 2 is hard. I don’t mean that in a bad way; if anything, that’s a huge compliment. Any and every hit could be your last, and when you’re running around arenas at a speed that would make a cheetah jealous, you’re bound to get hit at some point (where’s a Sandevistan when you need one?). However, the quick pace of restarting right back where you were, and every battle being an almost electrifying puzzle, keeps me coming back for more. Right now, you can get the entire experience at a massive 84% off—the lowest price it has ever been. Following the death of the Keymaster in the first game, Jack—the cyber-ninja turned tyranny-ending rebel—is tasked with taking on an AI cult that has begun to form outside Dharma Tower. There’s no rest when you’re a fast-running, enemy-slashing ninja, so you head out to stop the cult. Of course, it’s a lot easier said than done. Like the first game, Ghostrunner 2 has a "one hit and you’re dead" approach, making it a truly hardcore action game. Running across walls isn’t an escape like you may hope, as an enemy with a ranged weapon could take you out in a heartbeat. You need to be constantly on the move, and eventually, you’ll get up close with your attackers, cutting through them like a knife through butter. As you progress through the game, more challenges pop up. New enemies will force you to change your strategy constantly, while a variety of environmental puzzles will keep you on your toes. Combine the two, and, well, every level becomes a challenging trail of bodies as the rush of adrenaline fills your veins. It’s great. If you’ve been waiting for the right time to grab it, you can get Ghostrunner 2: Brutal Edition, which includes all of the game's DLC, for just $11.20 / £9.60 at Fanatical. That’s a massive 84% discount and the lowest price this underappreciated gem has ever been. You’ll get plenty of cosmetics and Endless Moto Mode for the ultimate motorcycle-slashing experience. Alternatively, you can also grab the base…

title: GTA 6 Players On PS5 Averaged 17+ Hours During First Weekend
description: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally here, and it's breaking records everywhere, including at PlayStation. The gaming giant has announced that GTA 6 is the "biggest launch in PlayStation history, a record that goes back 30+ years and five console generations. According to the gaming giant, more than 39 million unique players on PS5 have jumped into GTA 6 so far. Here is a quick rundown of GTA 6's new records on PS5 so far (covering the November 19-22 period): Highest number of concurrent players for any free or paid game on PlayStation, ahead of Fortnite, Call of Duty, and everything else. Players collectively logged 683 million hours of GTA 6 at launch, with each player spending an average of 17.4 hours in the game's first few days. GTA 6's launch led to the largest number of newly connected PS5 consoles on a single day since the system came out in 2020, and outside of the Christmas season. GTA 6 was the first game played on 70% of new PS5 consoles, which suggests a lot of people bought a system specifically for GTA 6. A big, record-breaking start for GTA 6 was always expected. If the game didn't break records, that would be a bigger story. Additionally, GTA 6 is an anomaly--its success will not save the AAA industry from its many serious, deep-rooted issues, experts have said, and many believe other publishers will learn all the wrong lessons. GTA 6 sold 32.5 million copies via pre-purchases alone and generated close to $4 billion on day one. The game will continue to sell, and it should get another jolt of sales when the PC edition arrives in 2027, as rumored.

title: Lego’s First Marvel Rivals Set Is A 495-Piece Tribute To The Game’s Most Adorable Terror
description: Next month marks the second anniversary of Marvel Rivals, and to celebrate, a new Lego set is on the way that lets you build the game's unofficial mascot, Jeff the Land Shark. While we regularly see Lego Marvel sets roll out, this is the first-ever Marvel Rivals kit, and it'll go on sale starting January 1, 2027, priced at $50. GameSpot can also exclusively reveal the first images of Jeff below, showing the completed build alongside his box art. See at The Lego Store The 495-piece set captures the adorable strategist in all his glory, including his big eyes, toothy smile, huge tongue, and even his collar. This won't be a static figure either: once fully assembled, Jeff has a movable head, legs, tail, and fins that let builders recreate his joyful trot, swimming, and battle poses. For added touches, his collar includes his signature name tag, his tongue can be removed to close his mouth, and his fin can be detached so builders can replicate Jeff's Hide-and-Seek movement ability from the game. "Jeff brings together everything players love about a breakout gaming character: an unforgettable silhouette, a personality you understand instantly, and the ability to turn any match into a story," Lego Marvel design lead Jesper C. Nielsen said in a press release. "We wanted this Lego model to capture both sides of him, from the lovable companion fans want beside their screen to the unpredictable strategist they meet in battle." Meanwhile, Jeff and the rest of the Marvel Rivals roster are preparing to cap off an entire year of Avengers-centric events that have been building up to the game's big Avengers: Doomsday tie-in. Season 11.5 kicks off on December 11. Nightcrawler was recently added to the game, bringing mutant energy, swords, and teleportation strategies, and he'll soon be followed by Marvel's unique take on Dracula, who has spent the last few months hibernating and healing for the battles ahead.

title: How To Unlock Hurricanes In GTA 6
description: Despite being used in advertising Leonida's dynamic weather, hurricanes are actually locked behind a secret mission in GTA 6. Be careful proceeding though, since after you witness your first hurricane, they can happen at any time, no matter what you're doing. First of all, you'll need to head to a very heavily fortified apocalypse bunker in North Leonard County. In the map below, you can see the icon marking these buildings. The red pin marks the location of the bunker. When you get nearer, a recording will warn you about automatic security defenses in place. There is a speaker where you can choose to say hello or ask to be let in, but both will be met with a message saying that unauthorized access is prohibited. Instead, head to the right and go around the concrete bunker until you see a yellow bulldozer in front of an orange container. Use the bulldozer to move the orange container. Image credit: MrDalekJD. In front of the container is a hole in the floor. Use the bulldozer to move the container so that you can go down the ladder that's now visible. Follow the sewer system for a short while until you see another ladder. Climb up through this and you'll find yourself inside the compound. This will trigger a security response--and you won't want to walk too far, since there are mines covering the ground. You can shoot the mines to detonate them if you're at a good distance away from them, but there are a lot. Use the grass and any elevated surfaces to your advantage to make your way towards the bunker, which is the round metal building in the northwest corner of the compound. At some point, a drone will begin seeking you out, so use focus mode to seek it out and shoot it down. Once you've made your way to the front door of the bunker, a pretty angry guy called Freddie will ask how you made it all the way in there. He's so angry, actually, that he'll send you away and tell you to come back once he's upgraded his defenses. Sure enough, you'll later receive a text…

title: How To Play GTA 6 On Your PC Or Phone Via Remote Play On Xbox
description: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 can be streamed via Xbox Cloud Gaming, and Microsoft has also now confirmed support for Remote Play on Xbox. This means you can play GTA 6 on your PC, smartphone, or a device like Xbox Rog Ally. Remote Play is an Xbox service that lets you stream games from your Xbox Series X|S to a device you might already have, and it's easy to get working. From your console, select Settings then Devices & connections then Remote features. From there, check the box for Enable remote features. Xbox Remote Play also has a "test" feature so you can preview the experience in your home environment before going further. From there, you can play GTA 6 from a mobile device by accessing the Xbox Remote Play website, selecting the console you want to connect to, and then the device. To play GTA 6 on your PC or Xbox Rog Ally, users can open the Xbox app for PC, click on their profile, then select Accessories & Remote Play and then select Remote Play to choose the device to play on. Additionally, people have spotted that GTA 6's store page on the PlayStation Store now mentions that Remote Play is supported and that PlayStation 5 and PlayStation Portal owners can use cloud streaming if they have a Premium membership. Right now, you need a PS5 or Xbox Series X|S to stream GTA 6, but some are dreaming of the day when you can simply stream the game to your PC or phone without any expensive hardware. That day may eventually come for GTA 6, as Take-Two's own CEO has said the rising cost of gaming hardware is not a good thing and that streaming games could be a big business very soon. “If you believe in streaming, and to be clear, we really do, and I’m happy to put a timeline on it. I think we’ll be in commercial streaming mode within three years, and by commercial, I mean low latency," Strauss Zelnick said. "That can 10x the effective installed base. title: GTA 6: How To Go To Hell And Fight Satan
description: Grand Theft Auto 6 gets downright weird when you go off the beaten track, and one secret mission will see you travel to the bowels of hell to fight Beezleboss himself, Satan. This detour is worth it because you'll get cool cosmetics and a powerful shotgun, plus a nice little bump to your health. Here's how you can start this Doom-inspired mission in GTA 6. How to go to Hell in GTA 6 You can find this mission in Port Gellhorn, Kelly County, and it's generally recommended that you tackle it once you've gotten your bearings in Chapter 2 of GTA 6. You can access it with either Jason or Lucia, and you'll need to follow these steps to find it: Start the mission at night, preferably around midnight. Go to the northern section of Port Gellhorn (as indicated on the maps) and look for the Circles of Hell, a house with an open garage. Inside the garage, you'll find two NPCs rocking out. Press L2 to highlight them and start talking. Select the dialogue options " Having fun? " and " It's good " when prompted. Follow the NPCs into a van that appears shortly afterward, and get inside. After being transported to the camping grounds, press L2 to stare into the campfire. Once you've done all that, you'll be taken to Hell, and you'll have to face off against an army of demons. Don't worry! You'll be equipped with a powerful shotgun, so you can mow down the demons and fight your way to Satan. The Prince of Darkness will occasionally summon reinforcements to defend him, but the denizens of hell are no match for a few well-placed shotgun rounds. Finish off the devils, and you'll wake up at the campsite. For your efforts, you'll be rewarded with the following items and upgrades: Circles of Hell top New tattoo design Hellspawn Comshot 12 shotgun (collect it next to the throne) Permanent health boost For a closer look at GTA 6's supernatural side, check out how to encounter an unkillable NPC, solve the Bigfoot mystery, and help out some friendly aliens. For more on GTA 6, from completing…

title: All GTA 6 Animals And Wildlife Spawn Locations
description: You can go birdwatching in GTA 6. Seriously. You can put aside that life of crime and take up the rather harmless hobby of logging new birds. It's not just birds, as there are reptiles, mammals, and marine animals in every county of the state of Leonida. Some are exotic, others common, and even some non-native creatures that are just plain weird to see here. Of course, you don't have to look for critters in GTA 6. Plenty of other side activities that aren't main missions are worth indulging in, such as finding all the WAiNK Sculptures and WAiNK landmarks, and reading all the magazines, books, and comics scattered throughout Leonida. You can even track down missing people if you've run out of animals to go hunting for. In This Article How to log Wildlife sightings How many of each animal are there? All GTA 6 Wildlife locations Mariana County Wildlife Locations Hunting Fishing Mammals Cats & Dogs Reptiles & Amphibians Birds Aquatic Other Kelly County Wildlife Locations Hunting Fishing Mammals Cats & Dogs Reptiles & Amphibians Birds Aquatic Other Fishing up the local catch is one way you can log animals into your collection. How to log Wildlife sightings There are three ways to log your sightings of each animal in GTA 6. The first is for any creature that is close to you. You can focus by holding L2/LT, then press and hold R1/RB to study that animal. Once you fill the circle, that creature will be logged in your wildlife sighting progression track, which you can look at by opening the sub-menu. If you'd rather not get up close and personal with an alligator, or if you're trying to track the many bird species in Leonida, you can equip the binoculars from your weapon wheel. You can zoom in using the D-Pad, but you'll need to track that animal as you use the Study prompt. This is certainly easier said than done, particularly for small or fast birds, but you'll eventually get the hang of it. title: How To Tow Away And Steal ATMs In GTA 6
description: There are hundreds of ATMs all over the world of Grand Theft Auto 6. To be fair, you’re not going to withdraw cash from them often, as it’s always better to keep money in your checking account or family savings account. So, if you don’t plan on withdrawing money, then perhaps you’d much rather steal it. Thankfully, you can do just that by using tow trucks and vans. In This Article Requirements: Towing vehicle and Dye Pack Jammer How to install the winch Heave-ho! Pulling away the ATM How to destroy stolen ATMs to get cash Requirements: Towing vehicle and Dye Pack Jammer If you want to steal ATMs in GTA 6, you need a vehicle that can tow them away and the Dye Pack Jammer to help maximize your take. When it comes to vehicles, your options include various types of tow trucks or pickup trucks, such as the Bravado Bison 1800 and Vapid Montagne Pickup. There are plenty of these vehicles being driven around by hapless civilians, so just steal one and take it out for a spin. As for the Dye Pack Jammer, it's a means of countering an anti-theft device: Basically, when an ATM or packets of marked money get stolen, there's a mechanism that releases pink ink. This defaces the bills and makes them useless. You also get covered in a bright color that makes it easier for cops to recognize you. To offset these issues, you must progress through the campaign until you get the Credit Check main mission in Chapter 3. Complete it to permanently unlock the Dye Pack Jammer, which prevents dye from ruining your robbery efforts. How to install the winch The vast majority of pickup trucks and tow trucks lug around trailer implements for tools, boats, and smaller vehicles. You don’t want those. Instead, you must install a winch. To install a winch, you have to visit a Mod Shop that specializes in that particular type of vehicle. For example, if you have a pickup truck, you need to head to Wasteland Off-road in Kelly County. Likewise, owners of the Ultimate Edition may also head to One-Eyed…

title: All Gym Locations In GTA 6
description: In Grand Theft Auto 6, a large emphasis is placed on Jason and Lucia working out and staying in shape. The better shape the characters are in, the higher their stats, which include health, stamina, and focus. So, if you want Jason and Lucia ready to fight enemies and run around Leonida, you need them in peak physical health. The best way to do that in GTA 6 is by visiting a gym, which you might have seen at Jason's safehouse in Chapter 1. However, following the events of Chapter 1, you'll need a new gym. Unfortunately, they become fairly hard to come by, especially during the earlier parts of the game. To save you time looking around Leonida, we have a full list of every gym location in GTA 6 ready for you in the guide below. In This Article How to find every gym in GTA 6 Zenith Vice Seven Condominiums Gym Grand Majestic Gym Dynamix Fitness Venus Fitness Ajax Gym/Lawton Theater Muscle Sands Y Hotel Fitness Club Aichi Condominiums Outdoor Gym How to find every gym in GTA 6 In total, we have been able to find nine gyms across Leonida in GTA 6. This doesn't include Jason's outdoor gym at his Key Lento house. For the most part, these gyms are located in and around downtown Vice City, as that's where all of the major bodybuilding occurs. You'll find some outdoor gyms, cheaper gyms with few amenities, and multi-level gyms that offer anything from a pool to billiards to a bar to dozens of unique weight-lifting machines and stations. Below, we'll show you the names, prices, and locations of all nine gyms in GTA 6 so you know exactly where to go to get ripped: Zenith Location: Just south of downtown Vice City and north of Tequesta Features: Food options and a wardrobe to change clothes Membership fee: $750 Vice Seven Condominiums Gym Location: In the heart of Tequesta, just above the "Tequesta" text on the map Features: None Membership fee: $450 Grand Majestic Gym Location: In south Tequesta and north of Peacock Bay Features: Food options and a billiards table Membership…

title: Xbox Project Helix Was Reportedly Designed To Make Online Multiplayer Free
description: For years, most multiplayer games on Xbox consoles required a subscription to go online. From Xbox Live to Xbox Game Pass, Microsoft paywalled multiplayer on its platforms, but the company reportedly aimed to break down that barrier for its next-gen console, Project Helix. According to Windows Central, Project Helix was conceived under the previous Xbox leadership team as the device that would bridge the divide between PC and console gaming. Like the Asus Xbox ROG Ally PC handhelds, the console is said to have an Xbox-inspired interface and full PC game support through storefronts like Steam. Because of that design decision, it's claimed it didn't make sense to continue with paid multiplayer, since that service is free for games purchased on PC platforms like Steam and the Epic Games Store. As the Windows Central report noted, that was reportedly the plan before Xbox leadership was shaken up and gaming hardware prices rose during the AI boom. With Asha Sharma now in charge of Xbox, the gaming division is more focused on profitability, and Microsoft's gaming arm has seen sweeping changes. Mass layoffs and studio divestitures occurred throughout 2026, and Project Helix could be a very expensive family of devices. If Microsoft ditches paid multiplayer, it loses a revenue stream for its next-gen push at a time when component prices have risen steeply. As part of its 25th anniversary celebrations, Microsoft also teased a few more details about Project Helix, calling it specifically "a console" that plays games from your PC, not "a PC that can also play console games." "When we think about Project Helix, it’s really designed to be the ultimate gaming machine--one that removes all the barriers of play that have historically existed," VP of next-gen Jason Ronald said.

title: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2 captures the franchise's bloody absurdity like nothing else
description: Warhammer 40,000 is a universe of two distinct moods. title: GTA 6 Hacker Releases Full Xbox Build, And PC Modders Are Already Trying To Get It Running
description: Infamous GTA 6 Leaker Cyberleek resurfaced last week, threatening to release a crucial file for the Xbox build of GTA 6 that could be used to create an unofficial PC port of the game. The hacker originally promised to publicly drop the.exe file for this version of the game depending on whether their memecoin hit a certain market cap, and has been taunting publisher Take-Two Interactive for failing to prevent the game files from leaking online. "Months of takedowns, subpoenas, and wallet-tracing later, the hunt is still on and the uploads keep arriving," Cyberleek wrote in a now-removed post on Reddit, insisting they were "fighting anti-consumerism" in the video games industry with their actions and using crypto funds to work on a new project. "There is no other way to move funds without names," Cyberleek added. "And this work requires no names." As pointed out online, Cyberleek has already cashed out on their memecoin in August and again in October, raking in hundreds of thousands of US dollars. So far, it looks like modders are already making modest headway with the full Xbox build of GTA 6, as the Project Leonida Discord server (via Eurogamer) has footage of the game booting up on PC. That's as far as it gets (for now), as that start-up process is met with a black screen shortly afterward. Modders and homebrew enthusiasts are reportedly using Claude AI to reverse-engineer the game on that platform, and the group is confident that a playable build will be ready within a week. Rockstar has yet to officially announce a PC port of GTA 6, but rumors suggest it could be out in early 2027. This would be a very short gap between console and PC releases for a Rockstar-developed game, as the studio's console-first projects usually spend many months in incubation before heading to PC. The threat of a homebrewed PC port, however, could pressure the developer to release GTA 6 on PC sooner rather than later. Meanwhile, GTA 6 has done phenomenally well on PS5 and Xbox Series…
